the development of a fully autonomous micro aerial vehicle capable of navigating through complex environments.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a complete system for the autonomous flight of a MAV in restricted indoor and outdoor environments.
the system is able to detect obstacles in the surrounding environment, to plan a collision-free trajectory to the goal and to follow the planned trajectory in a reactive way.

a multimodal sensor fusion approach can significantly increase the robustness of autonomous navigation in complex environments.

a combination of multiple sensor modalities is essential for robust obstacle perception and that a multi-layered trajectory planning approach is essential for the autonomous operation of micro unmanned aerial vehicles.
